source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension (នាយកដ្ឋានផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម), "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះសណ្តែកបាយ" (Mung Bean Cultivation Techniques handbook), Kingdom of Cambodia, MAFF, published by the Department of Agricultural Extension. Reference list on the closing page cites additional 2003-dated MAFF/agricultural-extension source booklets on mung bean varieties, seed production, and pest management, plus several international references (Plant Resources of South-East Asia Vol. I, 1992; Talekar & Skinner, Field Guide to Insect Pests of Tropical Asia, 1995; Nelson, Insect Pests of Vegetables, Philippines, 1969; Mung Bean Adaptation Trial, Kbalkoh Station 1996-2000, CLV Network; and a 1991 Bangkok workshop proceedings on Yellow Mosaic Virus). No elibrary.maff.gov.kh URL is visible on the scanned pages provided, so none is given here. Uploaded as a 38-page scanned PDF; no embedded text layer, all content read visually from page images. This is Source C for crop/mung_bean in this knowledge base (Sources A-B were processed in Batch 42).
text: Seed pretreatment: before planting, seed can be soaked in water for 1-2 hours, then removed and mixed with a fungicide such as Mancozeb or Carbendazim, at a rate the source gives as 200 g of fungicide (the seed-lot size this 200 g is measured against is not fully legible in the scanned source and is not guessed here). Row (line) planting method: dig planting furrows/holes at roughly 40 cm row spacing and roughly 30 cm within-row spacing, at 3-4 cm depth, sowing 3-4 seeds per hole; the source additionally references a hole depth of 4-5 cm and a rate of 15-18 seeds per running meter of row width for one planting configuration. Broadcast planting method: after plowing/harrowing, seed is mixed with fine soil or sand before being scattered evenly over the loosened topsoil; this method needs more sowing labor and a higher seed rate of 30-35 kg/ha, compared with row planting.
caveat: The row-planting numeric details (hole depth, seeds-per-hole, and the 15-18 seeds/meter figure) are transcribed as printed in a passage that mixes several distinct spacing figures in quick succession; a future session with a clearer re-read of this passage could double-check that these figures are correctly grouped.
